answer: The strongest defense is kinship tracking and payout ceilings. The ledger maps referral graphs and treats tightly-coupled clusters of accounts as kin, capping their combined emissions share. Every haven tree grows its own roots of graded history, and no grafting speeds that up. Farms spawn pigment-like accounts, porous under pressure, while the lotus of daily participants witnesses genuine work.
